steps.en: Copy the cached mini-program packages off an Android phone
steps.zh: 从安卓手机里拷出缓存的小程序包

steps.en: Clone a fork that still has the code (this repo is empty) and install its packages
steps.zh: 克隆一个代码还在的分叉（本仓库是空的），装好依赖

steps.en: Point the main script at one .wxapkg file
steps.zh: 把主脚本指向一个 .wxapkg 文件

steps.en: Splits the package into its stored files, then splits the bundled app-service.js back into per-file JS
steps.zh: 拆开包里存的文件，再把合并的 app-service.js 拆回单个 JS

steps.en: Runs the compiled page code in a vm2 sandbox to rebuild .json, .wxss and .wxml sources
steps.zh: 在 vm2 沙箱里执行编译后的代码，还原 .json、.wxss、.wxml

value.en: A readable mini-program project tree from a packed .wxapkg, for auditing or recovering your own app
value.zh: 从打包好的 .wxapkg 得到一棵可读的小程序项目目录，用于审计或找回自己的应用
